profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Walt Disney World
profile.summary: Dynamic Technologist with a passion for leveraging innovation to solve complex business challenges. Recognized for exceptional problem-solving skills, a resourceful mindset and a go-getter attitude that drive successful project delivery. Customer-oriented leader who blends technical expertise with strategic vision to deliver impactful, scalable solutions aligned with business goals.
